statement:
∀ (c : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    ⋃ n, Ioo (c / (↑n + 2)) c = Ioo 0 c ∧
      ∀ (N : ℕ), c / (↑N + 2) ∈ Ioo 0 c ∧ c / (↑N + 2) ∉ ⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, Ioo (c / (↑n + 2)) c
script:
# name: set-cover-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Compact.cover_no_finite_subcover
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c), (⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c) = Ioo 0 c ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, c / (N + 2) ∈ Ioo 0 c ∧ c / (N + 2) ∉ ⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c := by
  intro c hc
  refine ⟨?_, fun N => ⟨⟨by positivity, by rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · ext x
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨lt_trans (by positivity) h1, h2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (c / x)
      refine ⟨n, ?_, h2⟩
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h1] at hn
      nlinarith
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, Finset.mem_range, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n hn h
    exfalso
    have : c / (N + 2) ≤ c / (n + 2) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hc.le (by positivity)
      have : (n : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hn
      linarith
    linarith
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c), (⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c) = Ioo 0 c ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, c / (N + 2) ∈ Ioo 0 c ∧ c / (N + 2) ∉ ⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c := by
  intro c hc
  refine ⟨?_, fun N => ⟨⟨by positivity, by rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · ext x
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨lt_trans (by positivity) h1, h2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (c / x)
      refine ⟨n, ?_, h2⟩
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h1] at hn
      nlinarith
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, Finset.mem_range, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n hn h
    exfalso
    have : c / (N + 2) ≤ c / (n + 2) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hc.le (by positivity)
      have : (n : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hn
      linarith
    linarith
exact @key (2) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['1/2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c), (⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c) = Ioo 0 c ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, c / (N + 2) ∈ Ioo 0 c ∧ c / (N + 2) ∉ ⋃ n ∈ Finset.range N, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c := by
  intro c hc
  refine ⟨?_, fun N => ⟨⟨by positivity, by rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · ext x
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨lt_trans (by positivity) h1, h2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (c / x)
      refine ⟨n, ?_, h2⟩
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h1] at hn
      nlinarith
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, Finset.mem_range, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n hn h
    exfalso
    have : c / (N + 2) ≤ c / (n + 2) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hc.le (by positivity)
      have : (n : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hn
      linarith
    linarith
exact @key (1/2) ((by norm_num))'),
]
